name: upsertDocumentType
body: mutation upsertDocumentType($id: ID!, $name: String) { dictionaryPacket { updateOrCreateDocumentType(input: { id: $id, name: $name }) { created returning { id name } } } }

name: refDocumentTypeListGet
body: query refDocumentTypeListGet { searchDocumentType { elems { id name } count } }

name: upsertDocumentProcessSettings
body: mutation upsertDocumentProcessSettings($id: ID!, $documentType: ID!, $processId: String, $enabled: Boolean) { dictionaryPacket { updateOrCreateDocumentProcessSettings(input: { id: $id, documentType: $documentType, processId: $processId, enabled: $enabled }) { created returning { id documentType { id name } processId enabled } } } }

name: searchDocumentProcessSettings
body: query searchDocumentProcessSettings($offset: Int, $limit: Int, $cond: String) { searchDocumentProcessSettings(offset: $offset, limit: $limit, cond: $cond) { elems { id documentType { id name } processId enabled } count } }

name: searchPdsContract
body: query searchPdsContract($offset: Int, $limit: Int, $cond: String, $sort: [_SortCriterionSpecification!]) { searchPdsContract(offset: $offset, limit: $limit, cond: $cond, sort: $sort) { elems { id documentId documentType { id name } contractDate contractNumber snils approvalStatus createdBy createdAt assignee attachmentsHead historyInitialized } count } }

name: createPdsContract
body: mutation createPdsContract($input: _CreatePdsContractInput!) { packet { createPdsContract(input: $input) { id documentId documentType { id name } contractDate contractNumber snils approvalStatus createdBy createdAt assignee } } }

name: editPdsContract
body: mutation editPdsContract($id: ID!, $documentType: ID!, $contractDate: _Date!, $contractNumber: String!, $snils: String!) { packet { updatePdsContract(input: { id: $id, documentType: $documentType, contractDate: $contractDate, contractNumber: $contractNumber, snils: $snils }) { id approvalStatus assignee } } }

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${id} && it.historyInitialized == true && it.approvalStatus == 'IN_WORK' && it.assignee == ${jwt:preferred_username} && it.documentType.$id == ${documentType}
checkSelects.description: Only assigned operator may edit attributes; document type is bound to the original process

name: createAttachment
body: mutation createAttachment($input: _CreateAttachmentInput!, $changeId: String!, $contractId: ID!, $change: _CreateAttachmentChangeInput!) { packet { createAttachment(input: $input) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } createAttachmentChange(input: $change) { id } updatePdsContract(input: { id: $contractId, attachmentsHead: $changeId }) { id } } }

checkSelects.description: Only assigned operator can create attachments while document is in work

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${contractId} && it.documentId == ${change.documentId} && it.historyInitialized == true && ((it.attachmentsHead == null && ${change.previousId} == '' && ${change.previousKey} == it.documentId) || (it.attachmentsHead == ${change.previousId} && ${change.previousKey} == ${change.previousId}))
checkSelects.description: Composition must extend the current head; unique previousKey atomically prevents forks
Bind file operation to the same contract
Composition must reference the newly created immutable file version

name: searchAttachment
body: query searchAttachment($cond: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { searchAttachment(cond: $cond, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { elems { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } count } }

name: replaceAttachmentVersion
body: mutation replaceAttachmentVersion($currentAttachmentId: ID!, $input: _CreateAttachmentInput!, $changeId: String!, $contractId: ID!, $change: _CreateAttachmentChangeInput!) { packet { updateAttachment(input: { id: $currentAttachmentId, current: false }) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId version current } createAttachment(input: $input) { id attachmentId logicalAttachmentId documentId fileName contentType size storageReference version current uploadedAt } createAttachmentChange(input: $change) { id } updatePdsContract(input: { id: $contractId, attachmentsHead: $changeId }) { id } } }

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${currentAttachmentId} && it.documentId == ${input.documentId} && it.current == true && (it.logicalAttachmentId == ${input.logicalAttachmentId} || (it.logicalAttachmentId == null && (it.attachmentId == ${input.logicalAttachmentId} || it.$id == ${input.logicalAttachmentId}))) && (${Integer:input.version} == it.version + 1 || (it.version == null && ${Integer:input.version} == 2))
checkSelects.description: Only current attachment version can be replaced
Only assigned operator can replace attachments while document is in work

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${contractId} && it.documentId == ${change.documentId} && it.historyInitialized == true && ((it.attachmentsHead == null && ${change.previousId} == '' && ${change.previousKey} == it.documentId) || (it.attachmentsHead == ${change.previousId} && ${change.previousKey} == ${change.previousId}))
checkSelects.description: Composition must extend the current head; unique previousKey atomically prevents forks
Bind file operation to the same contract
Composition must reference the newly created immutable file version

name: deleteAttachment
body: mutation deleteAttachment($id: ID!, $documentId: String!, $changeId: String!, $contractId: ID!, $change: _CreateAttachmentChangeInput!) { packet { createAttachmentChange(input: $change) { id } updatePdsContract(input: { id: $contractId, attachmentsHead: $changeId }) { id } updateAttachment(input: { id: $id, current: false }) { id } } }

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${id} && it.documentId == ${documentId} && it.current == true && ${change.attachmentId} == it.$id && ${Boolean:change.removed} == true
checkSelects.description: Only attachments of the requested document can be deleted
Only assigned operator can delete attachments while document is in work

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${contractId} && it.documentId == ${change.documentId} && it.historyInitialized == true && ((it.attachmentsHead == null && ${change.previousId} == '' && ${change.previousKey} == it.documentId) || (it.attachmentsHead == ${change.previousId} && ${change.previousKey} == ${change.previousId}))
checkSelects.description: Composition must extend the current head; unique previousKey atomically prevents forks
Bind file operation to the same contract

name: documentStates
body: query documentStates($id: ID!, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { getStatesPdsContract(id: $id, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { elems { sysHistNumber sysHistoryTime documentId documentType { id name } contractDate contractNumber snils approvalStatus createdBy createdAt assignee attachmentsHead historyInitialized } count } }

name: attachmentComposition
body: query attachmentComposition($cond: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { searchAttachmentChange(cond: $cond, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { elems { id changeKey documentId documentType previousId removed attachmentId baselineAttachments(offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { elems { attachmentId } count } } count } }

name: updatePdsContract
body: mutation updatePdsContract($input: _UpdatePdsContractInput!) { packet { updatePdsContract(input: $input) { id approvalStatus assignee } } }

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${input.id} && ${input.documentId} == null && ${input.documentType} == null && ${input.contractDate} == null && ${input.contractNumber} == null && ${input.snils} == null && ${input.createdBy} == null && ${input.createdAt} == null && ${input.attachmentsHead} == null && ${Boolean:input.historyInitialized} == null
checkSelects.description: Running BPM instances can update only workflow fields

name: initializeDocumentHistory
body: mutation initializeDocumentHistory($input: _UpdatePdsContractInput!, $baseline: _CreateAttachmentChangeInput!, $links: [_CreateAttachmentBaselineInput!]!) { packet { createAttachmentChange(input: $baseline) { id } createManyAttachmentBaseline(input: $links) updatePdsContract(input: $input) { id historyInitialized } } }

checkSelects.conditionValue: it.$id == ${input.id} && (it.historyInitialized == null || it.historyInitialized == false) && it.documentId == ${baseline.documentId} && ${input.attachmentsHead} == ${baseline.changeKey} && ${Boolean:input.historyInitialized} == true
checkSelects.description: One-time baseline for existing documents during maintenance
